TEXT.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

S.FORM: Siæ̈æugh ki anna ni-d'ma-rang ta ti Jesus mou-a-rough ki vaoung ka tou Galilæa, [ka vaoung] ki Tiberias.
S.TRANSL: After these things Jesus went over the sea of Galilee, which is the sea of Tiberias.
這事以後，耶穌渡過加利利海，就是提比哩亞海。

S.FORM: Ka ni-smala-dyllough tyni-æn ta makoi-lalaulau ka maba-toung, alei ka k'ak'yt-tan nein ta na pou-kakidi tyn, ka pa-am't-ten tyn ki maälam.
S.TRANSL: And a great multitude followed him, because they saw his miracles which he did on them that were diseased.
有許多人因為看見他在病人身上所行的神蹟，就跟隨他。

S.FORM: Ka ni-mou-voukkyn ta ti Jesus, mierroung hynna i-tou lam ki Pæhtatæutæu-en tyn.
S.TRANSL: And Jesus went up into a mountain, and there he sat with his disciples.
耶穌上了山，和門徒一同坐在那裏。

S.FORM: Ka tou tamang ta Ou-vava-toug-han ki Hali-daeu-en ki Joden.
S.TRANSL: And the passover, a feast of the Jews, was nigh.
那時猶太人的逾越節近了。

S.FORM: Irou ka pa-passa ou-vavau ta ti Jesus ki matta, ka k'yt-tan tyn makoi-lalaulau ka maba-toung ka mou-koua tyniæn, ni-k'ma ti Filippus-an, Peill'-au-mytta toumang ki paoul alei ka mavok-kah ta neni k'atta?
S.TRANSL: When Jesus then lifted up his eyes, and saw a great company come unto him, he saith unto Philip, Whence shall we buy bread, that these may eat?
耶穌舉目看見許多人來，就對腓力說：「我們從哪裏買餅叫這些人吃呢？」（

S.FORM: (Râ ni-pa-sousou-en tyn ta atta tou rihpung-en tyni-æn: ka kavan'-nan tyn mang ta ringei-ah tyn.)
S.TRANSL: And this he said to prove him: for he himself knew what he would do.
他說這話是要試驗腓力；他自己原知道要怎樣行。）

S.FORM: Ni-mattæ'i-vli ta ti Filip-pus tyni-æn, Rou-rouha kæ'æ̈-toug-han ki loumari ki paoul assi mamsing-ah neini-æn k'atta, alei ka a-tyttyng-ah mara ta maiboä voual neini-æn.
S.TRANSL: Philip answered him, Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may take a little.
腓力回答說：「就是二十兩銀子的餅，叫他們各人吃一點也是不夠的。」

S.FORM: Saat ki Pæhtatæutæu'-en tyn, ka ti Andreas, ka tæ'i-äpara ti Simon Petrus, ta ni-k'ma tyni-æn,
S.TRANSL: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, saith unto him,
有一個門徒，就是西門‧彼得的兄弟安得烈，對耶穌說：

S.FORM: Tou hia ta saät ka rauwei ka akoumea ki ryrrymma ki paoul rourouhä appa ki t'hing ra mang-ah k'atta tou kabatoung-an ka kmahynna?
S.TRANSL: There is a lad here, which hath five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?
「在這裏有一個孩童，帶着五個大麥餅、兩條魚，只是分給這許多人還算甚麼呢？」

S.FORM: Ka ni-k'ma ta ti Jesus, Pa-ierroung-au-to ta ta'u: ka madagh hynna ta ahkægh tou itoukou-an kanna. Ka ni-mierroung ta pæ-pæræh rymma katou-noun-nan lava ki vouel.
S.TRANSL: And Jesus said, Make the men sit down. Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.
耶穌說：「你們叫眾人坐下。」原來那地方的草多，眾人就坐下，數目約有五千。

S.FORM: Ka ni-ara ti Jesus ta paoul, ka rou ni-pakou-vli-en tyn ma-kou-Alilid ni-matatatagh ki Pæh-tætæutæu-'en, ka Pæhtætæutæu-'en [ta ni-matatagh] neini-æn ka mierroung-ato: mahkaulaula ki na t'hing, kma-hynna ki dagh ma-ma ki kamoei-in nein.
S.TRANSL: And Jesus took the loaves; and when he had given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to them that were set down; and likewise of the fishes as much as they would.
耶穌拿起餅來，祝謝了，就分給那坐着的人；分魚也是這樣，都隨着他們所要的。

S.FORM: Irou ka mi-bantau ta ne-ni, ni-k'ma ki Pæhtætæutæu-'en tyn, Illud-dâ ki ni-pihpi ka ni-'kda, alei ka assi taurumm'-ah ta mamang
S.TRANSL: When they were filled, he said unto his disciples, Gather up the fragments that remain, that nothing be lost.
他們吃飽了，耶穌對門徒說：「把剩下的零碎收拾起來，免得有糟蹋的。」

S.FORM: Anna ta ni-illud-dan nein pou-tamoei sat-kyttiæn æb ki rouha ka læi-an ki ni-pihpi ki paoul k'anna ka ryrrimma ka na tavæh, ka ni-'kda nein kman.
S.TRANSL: Therefore they gathered them together, and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves, which remained over and above unto them that had eaten.
他們便將那五個大麥餅的零碎，就是眾人吃了剩下的，收拾起來，裝滿了十二個籃子。

S.FORM: Irou ka ni-kmytta ta ta'u ki na poukakidi ti Jesus, ni-k'ma , Missing ti atta ta Tama-Mattæ'i-Tan k'anna ka iro'-âl-a-to tou næi.
S.TRANSL: Then those men, when they had seen the miracle that Jesus did, said, This is of a truth that prophet that should come into the world.
眾人看見耶穌所行的神蹟，就說：「這真是那要到世間來的先知！」

S.FORM: . Irou ka kavan-'nan ti Je-sus ka iro'-ei nein mourang bihyt tyni-æn ka pa-pei-sasou-eih pa-sihbavau ta teni, ni-sa-lala sa-onni mou-voukkyn tou saät.
S.TRANSL: When Jesus therefore perceived that they would come and take him by force, to make him a king, he departed again into a mountain himself alone.
耶穌既知道眾人要來強逼他作王，就獨自又退到山上去了。

S.FORM: Ka rou madoung-ato, ni-'tdarim ta Pæhtatæutæu-han tyn mou-vaoung.
S.TRANSL: And when even was now come, his disciples went down unto the sea,
到了晚上，他的門徒下海邊去，

S.FORM: Ka rou ni-mou-avang ni-mou-arouh ta neni ki vaoung mou-koua tou Kapernaum. Ka marimdim-mato, ka assi appa irou'-âto ta ti Jesus neini-æn.
S.TRANSL: And entered into a ship, and went over the sea toward Capernaum. And it was now dark, and Jesus was not come to them.
上了船，要過海往迦百農去。天已經黑了，耶穌還沒有來到他們那裏。

S.FORM: Ka ni-rmarouar ta vaoung alei ka ni-bavare ta vare ka vei-joegh.
S.TRANSL: And the sea arose by reason of a great wind that blew.
忽然狂風大作，海就翻騰起來。

S.FORM: Irou ka ni-tau-avang rou-ha kyttiæn æb ki rymma lava ki touro lava kyttiæn ki stadien [ka na pta ki darang] ni-kmytta ta ne-ni ti Jesus-an ka mou-naunang hmi-halap [ki raloum] ki va-oung, mou-hylli ki avang, ka ni-mahttakout ta neni.
S.TRANSL: So when they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs, they see Jesus walking on the sea, and drawing nigh unto the ship: and they were afraid.
門徒搖櫓，約行了十里多路，看見耶穌在海面上走，漸漸近了船，他們就害怕。

S.FORM: Ra ni-kma ta teni nei-ni-æn; Ti jau, ynnâ maht-ta, kout.
S.TRANSL: But he saith unto them, It is I; be not afraid.
耶穌對他們說：「是我，不要怕！」

S.FORM: Ka ni-masa-roul ta neni pou-avang tyni-æn: ka madys ni-mou-hili ta avang ki pourough ka 'ou-koua-ei-nein.
S.TRANSL: Then they willingly received him into the ship: and immediately the ship was at the land whither they went.
門徒就喜歡接他上船，船立時到了他們所要去的地方。

S.FORM: Tou sasat-appa ki wæ'i ka tou æ̈æugh, irou ka kmytta ta ma-koilalaulau ka tou arough ki va-oung, ka ä'ou-si hynna ki pani ki avang dyk saäsat k'anna, ki ni-pakdakkin-nin ki Pæhtatæutæu-han tyn, ka assi ni-tau-lam ta ti Jesus ki Pæhtatæutæu-han tyn tau-avang, ra ni-mou-ayang mou-snagh ta Pæhtatæutæu-han tyn:
S.TRANSL: The day following, when the people which stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was none other boat there, save that one whereinto his disciples were entered, and that Jesus went not with his disciples into the boat, but that his disciples were gone away alone;
第二日，站在海那邊的眾人知道那裏沒有別的船，只有一隻小船，又知道耶穌沒有同他的門徒上船，乃是門徒自己去的。

S.FORM: (Ra pani ki avang ta ni-ier-roua makka Tiberias mou-hylli ki i-tou-kou'an k'anna, ki ni-k'an nein ta paoul, ro ni-makou-vli makou-Alilid ta Meirang.)
S.TRANSL: (Howbeit there came other boats from Tiberias nigh unto the place where they did eat bread, after that the Lord had given thanks:)
然而，有幾隻小船從提比哩亞來，靠近主祝謝後分餅給人吃的地方。

S.FORM: Irou ka ni-kmytta ta ma-koilalaulau ka ä'ou-si hynna ta ti Jesus ki Pæhtatæutæu-han appa tyn, nimou-avang appa ta neni, mou-koua tou Kapernaum, ka kma kiym ti Jesus-an.
S.TRANSL: When the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there, neither his disciples, they also took shipping, and came to Capernaum, seeking for Jesus.
眾人見耶穌和門徒都不在那裏，就上了船，往迦百農去找耶穌。

S.FORM: Ka rou ni-ma-ki-valei ta neni tyni-æn tou arouh ki va-oung, ni-k'ma tyni-æn, Rab-bi, ni-ierroua-kow ka mannou hiä?
S.TRANSL: And when they had found him on the other side of the sea, they said unto him, Rabbi, when camest thou hither?
既在海那邊找着了，就對他說：「拉比，是幾時到這裏來的？」

S.FORM: Ni-mattæ'i-vli ta ti Jesus k'ma neini-æn, Missing, missing koun-nau-kamou, kma-ki'ym-kamou jau-an, assi alei ka ni-k'yt-ta-'n-noumi ta pou-kidi-en, alei-appa ka ni-kman-kamou ki paoul 'k-bantau.
S.TRANSL: Jesus answered them and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Ye seek me, not because ye saw the miracles, but because ye did eat of the loaves, and were filled.
耶穌回答說：「我實實在在地告訴你們，你們找我，並不是因見了神蹟，乃是因吃餅得飽。

S.FORM: Ynnâ mapoungas [alei] ki avovok-kun ka sa-nynno, râ [a-lei-appa] ki avokkun ka mæ-'ylli tou kæuag-han ka myhkaqua myddaryn-nough, ka phæ-æn-neih ymoumi-æn ta Alak ki kaeu-loung: ka teni k'atta ta ni-pou-ta-pœjou-en ki Alid Rama.
S.TRANSL: Labour not for the meat which perisheth, but for that meat which endureth unto everlasting life, which the Son of man shall give unto you: for him hath God the Father sealed.
不要為那必壞的食物勞力，要為那存到永生的食物勞力，就是人子要賜給你們的，因為人子是父上帝所印證的。」

S.FORM: Anna ta ni k'ma ta neni ty-ni-æn, Oumang-ah-kame, alei ka kapoungas-au-mian ta papei-ra ryngä-ryngei ki Alid?
S.TRANSL: Then said they unto him, What shall we do, that we might work the works of God?
眾人問他說：「我們當行甚麼才算做上帝的工呢？」

S.FORM: Ni-mattæ'i-vli ta ti Jesus k'ma neini-æn, Atta ta pei-ra-ryngaryngei ki Alid, ka tna-msing-ah-kamou tyni-æn, ka ni-padingi-en tyn.
S.TRANSL: Jesus answered and said unto them, This is the work of God, that ye believe on him whom he hath sent.
耶穌回答說：「信上帝所差來的，這就是做上帝的工。」

S.FORM: Annata ni-k'ma ta neni ty-ni-æn , Pou-kidi-en ki mang ka pa-am't-en-hou alei ka k'ytt-ei-mian ta atta tna-msing ymhou-an? Mapoungas-kow ki mang?
S.TRANSL: They said therefore unto him, What sign shewest thou then, that we may see, and believe thee? what dost thou work?
他們又說：「你行甚麼神蹟，叫我們看見就信你；你到底做甚麼事呢？

S.FORM: Ni-k'man ta na ramou-jan ki Manna tou poulægh: mama ki ni-soulat-ten-da, Ni-phen tyn pavok neini-æn ki paoul ka mak-ka vullum.
S.TRANSL: Our fathers did eat manna in the desert; as it is written, He gave them bread from heaven to eat.
我們的祖宗在曠野吃過嗎哪，如經上寫着說：『他從天上賜下糧來給他們吃。』」

S.FORM: Annata ni-k'ma ta ti Jesus neini-æn, Missing, missing koun-nau-kamou-ra, assi ni-pi-'æ̈ ta ti Moses ymou-mi-æn ki paoul ka makka vullum: ra Raram-appa-mau ta pi-æ̈' ymoumi-æn ki paoul ka d'lligh ka makka tounnoun ki vullum.
S.TRANSL: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Moses gave you not that bread from heaven; but my Father giveth you the true bread from heaven.
耶穌說：「我實實在在地告訴你們，那從天上來的糧不是摩西賜給你們的，乃是我父將天上來的真糧賜給你們。

S.FORM: Ka paoul ki Alid ta teni ka ni-mourarim makka toun-noun ki vullum, ka pi-'æ̈ ki kæu-ag-han ki næi.
S.TRANSL: For the bread of God is he which cometh down from heaven, and giveth life unto the world.
因為上帝的糧就是那從天上降下來、賜生命給世界的。」

S.FORM: Annata ni-k'ma ta neni ty-ni-æn, Meirang, pæ'æ̈-kakou'-ei-kame ki paoul katta.
S.TRANSL: Then said they unto him, Lord, evermore give us this bread.
他們說：「主啊，常將這糧賜給我們！」

S.FORM: Ni-k'ma ta ti Jesus neini-æn, Ti jau ta paoul ki kæuag-han: ti-mamang ta mou-koua jau-an, myhkakoua assi mi-hgangei-ah: timamang appa ta tna-msing jau-an, myhkakoua assi meitou-ah.
S.TRANSL: And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.
耶穌說：「我就是生命的糧。到我這裏來的，必定不餓；信我的，永遠不渴。

S.FORM: Ra ni-pasousou-en-nau-kamou ka ni-k'ytta-n-noumi jau-an, ka assi-kamou tna-msing-ato.
S.TRANSL: But I said unto you, That ye also have seen me, and believe not.
只是我對你們說過，你們已經看見我，還是不信。

S.FORM: Kamamang ka phæn-koh ki Rama moukou-ah jau-an: ka ti-maman ta moukoua jau-an, assi-mau s'aki-tau wagh-an-ei ta teni.
S.TRANSL: All that the Father giveth me shall come to me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.
凡父所賜給我的人必到我這裏來；到我這裏來的，我總不丟棄他。

S.FORM: Ka ni-mou-rarim-koh makka tounnoun ki vullum, assi alei ka pa'-m't-au-mau ta kamoei-en-nau, râ kamoei-in appa tyn ka ni-madingi jau-an.
S.TRANSL: For I came down from heaven, not to do mine own will, but the will of him that sent me.
因為我從天上降下來，不是要按自己的意思行，乃是要按那差我來者的意思行。

S.FORM: Atta ta kamoei-in ki Ra-ma ka ni-madingi jau-an, ka assi-koh patau-rumma-ah ki ma-mang ki ni-phæn tyn jau-an, ra paæhpit-ei-mau k'anna tou wæ'i ka tou æ̈æugh.
S.TRANSL: And this is the Father's will which hath sent me, that of all which he hath given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up again at the last day.
差我來者的意思就是：他所賜給我的，叫我一個也不失落，在末日卻叫他復活。

S.FORM: Att'-appa ta kamoei-in tyn ka ni-madingi jau-an, ym-mid ka mararau ki Alak tna-msing tyni-æn, akoumea ki kæuag-han ka myhkakoua myd-darynnough: ka pa-æhpit-ei-mau ta teni tou wæ'i ka tou æ̈-æugh.
S.TRANSL: And this is the will of him that sent me, that every one which seeth the Son, and believeth on him, may have everlasting life: and I will raise him up at the last day.
因為我父的意思是叫一切見子而信的人得永生，並且在末日我要叫他復活。」

S.FORM: Ka ni-mimææurmour ta Joden tyni-æn alei ki na sou tyn, Ti jau ta paoul ka ni-mou-ra-rim makka tounnoun ki vul-lum.
S.TRANSL: The Jews then murmured at him, because he said, I am the bread which came down from heaven.
猶太人因為耶穌說「我是從天上降下來的糧」，就私下議論他，

S.FORM: Ka ni-k'ma ta neni, Assi kauwa ti atta ta ti Jesus ka alak ti Josef, ka k'alang-'n-niæn ki Ra-ma ki raren'-an tyn? Mattæ'i-ma-ma ki mang ta ti atta, Ni-mou-ra-tim-koh makka tounnoun ki vullum?
S.TRANSL: And they said, Is not this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? how is it then that he saith, I came down from heaven?
說：「這不是約瑟的兒子耶穌嗎？他的父母我們豈不認得嗎？他如今怎麼說『我是從天上降下來的』呢？」

S.FORM: Annata ni-mattæ'i-v'li ta ti Jesus k'ma neini-æn, Ynna mäi-nadô-nadô mäi-mææu-rmour-rmour.
S.TRANSL: Jesus therefore answered and said unto them, Murmur not among yourselves.
耶穌回答說：「你們不要大家議論。

S.FORM: Assi mou-lpough ta ti-mamang mou-koua jau-an, rou assi vihyt-tyn ta teni ki Rama ka ni-madingi jau-an, ka pæ-æhpit-ei-mau ta teni tou wæ-'i ka tou æ̈æugh.
S.TRANSL: No man can come to me, except the Father which hath sent me draw him: and I will raise him up at the last day.
若不是差我來的父吸引人，就沒有能到我這裏來的；到我這裏來的，在末日我要叫他復活。

S.FORM: Ka ni-soulat-ten tou [na sasoulat] ki Tama-Mattæ'i-tan, Ka pah-kou-ymd-dih ta neni mæhtæutæu'ugh ki Alid. Annata ymmud ka ni-millingigh [ki atta] ki Rama, ka ni-pæhtæutæu'-en-n-appa, ta mou-koua jau-an.
S.TRANSL: It is written in the prophets, And they shall be all taught of God. Every man therefore that hath heard, and hath learned of the Father, cometh unto me.
在先知書上寫着說：『他們都要蒙上帝的教訓。』凡聽見父之教訓又學習的，就到我這裏來。

S.FORM: Assi ka ni-k'ytt'-an ta Ra-ma ti-mamang, dyk tyni-æn ka ni-makka-koua ki Alid: teni ta ni-kmytta ki Rama.
S.TRANSL: Not that any man hath seen the Father, save he which is of God, he hath seen the Father.
這不是說有人看見過父，惟獨從上帝來的，他看見過父。

S.FORM: Missing, missing koun-nau-kamou-ra, ti-mamang ta tna'-msing jau-an, akoumea ki kæuag-han ka myhkakoua myddaryn-nough.
S.TRANSL: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me hath everlasting life.
我實實在在地告訴你們，信的人有永生。

S.FORM: Ti jau ta paoul ki kæuag-han.
S.TRANSL: I am that bread of life.
我就是生命的糧。

S.FORM: Ni-kman ta na Ramou-oumi ki Manna tou poulægh, ka ni-mapatei ta neni.
S.TRANSL: Your fathers did eat manna in the wilderness, and are dead.
你們的祖宗在曠野吃過嗎哪，還是死了。

S.FORM: Atta ta paoul ka ni-mou-rarim makka tounnoun ki vul-lum, alei ka kman-ah ki atta ta ti-mamang ka taou, ka assi mapatei-ah ta teni.
S.TRANSL: This is the bread which cometh down from heaven, that a man may eat thereof, and not die.
這是從天上降下來的糧，叫人吃了就不死。

S.FORM: Ti jau ta paoul k'anna ka mæuagh ka ni-mou-rarim makka tounnoun ki vullum: ti-mamang ta kman ki paoul katta mæuæ̈-'ah ta teni tou yhkakouan mydda-rynnough. Ka paoul ka phæ-ei-mau vât-au k'anna, ka phæ-ei-mau alei ki kæuag-han ki næi.
S.TRANSL: I am the living bread which came down from heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: and the bread that I will give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.
我是從天上降下來生命的糧；人若吃這糧，就必永遠活着。我所要賜的糧就是我的肉，為世人之生命所賜的。」

S.FORM: Anna ta ni-macyt ki sou ta Joden mattæ'i-naunado, k'ma, 'Ilpough mama ki mang pakan ta ti atta ymytt-æn ki vaät tyn?
S.TRANSL: The Jews therefore strove among themselves, saying, How can this man give us his flesh to eat?
因此，猶太人彼此爭論說：「這個人怎能把他的肉給我們吃呢？」

S.FORM: Ni-k'ma ta ti Jesus nei-ni-æn, Missing, missing koun-nau-kamou, heirou assi-kamou kman ki vaät ki Alak ki kaeu-loung, ä'ou-si-kamou ki kæuag-han ymoumi-æn.
S.TRANSL: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except ye eat the flesh of the Son of man, and drink his blood, ye have no life in you.
耶穌說：「我實實在在地告訴你們，你們若不吃人子的肉，不喝人子的血，就沒有生命在你們裏面。

S.FORM: Ti-mamang ta kman ki vaät-au, ta myt ki 'æmagh-au akoumea ki kæuag-han ka myhkakoua myddarynnough: ka pæ-æhpit-au-mau ta teni tou wæi ka tou æ̈æugh.
S.TRANSL: Whoso eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, hath eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.
吃我肉、喝我血的人就有永生，在末日我要叫他復活。

S.FORM: Ka avokkun ka d'lligh ta vaät-au, yt appa ka diligh ta 'æ-magh-au.
S.TRANSL: For my flesh is meat indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.
我的肉真是可吃的，我的血真是可喝的。

S.FORM: Ti-mamang ta kman ki vaät-au, ta myt ki 'æmagh-au, i-tou-koua ta teni jau-an, ka i-tou-koua-app'-'oh tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: He that eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, dwelleth in me, and I in him.
吃我肉、喝我血的人常在我裏面，我也常在他裏面。

S.FORM: Mama ki ni-padingi-en-koh ki Rama ka mæuagh, ka kæ-uægh-en-nau alei ki Rama, [komma-hynna] ti-mamang ta kman jau-an, mæuæg-ah ta teni alei jau-an.
S.TRANSL: As the living Father hath sent me, and I live by the Father: so he that eateth me, even he shall live by me.
永活的父怎樣差我來，我又因父活着；照樣，吃我肉的人也要因我活着。

S.FORM: Atta ta paoul ka ni-mou-ra-rim makka tounnoun ki vullum. Assi mama ki ni-kan-nun ki na ramou-oumi ta Manna, ka ni-mapa-tei ta neni: ti-mamang ta kman ki paoul katta mæuæ'g-hah ta te-ni tou yhkakou'an myddaryn-nough.
S.TRANSL: This is that bread which came down from heaven: not as your fathers did eat manna, and are dead: he that eateth of this bread shall live for ever.
這就是從天上降下來的糧。吃這糧的人就永遠活着，不像你們的祖宗吃過嗎哪還是死了。」

S.FORM: Kamamang k'atta ni-pa-sousou-en tyn tou Pæui-sasaal-lan, dou mæhtæutæu'ug tou Ka-pernaum.
S.TRANSL: These things said he in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.
這些話是耶穌在迦百農會堂裏教訓人說的。

S.FORM: Mabatoung ki Pæhtatæu-tæu-han tyn ka millingigh [ki at-ta] ta ni k'ma, Mæt'æh ta sou kat-ta: ti-mang ta tna-lpoug ki atta millingigh.
S.TRANSL: Many therefore of his disciples, when they had heard this, said, This is an hard saying; who can hear it?
他的門徒中有好些人聽見了，就說：「這話甚難，誰能聽呢？」

S.FORM: Irou ka 'ou-mhgan ti Jesus mou-madou tyni-æn ka mimæ-æummæu alei ki atta ta Pæhta-tæutæu-han tyn, ni k'ma neini-æn, Pa-saisala kouap kaua ta atta pa-ka-te ymoumi-æn?
S.TRANSL: When Jesus knew in himself that his disciples murmured at it, he said unto them, Doth this offend you?
耶穌心裏知道門徒為這話議論，就對他們說：「這話是叫你們厭棄嗎？

S.FORM: Ou-mang- [âl-ato] rou kmytt'-ah-kamou ki Alak ki ka-æuloung ka sa-bavau tou ni-itou-aurou-en tyn i-tou-koua?
S.TRANSL: What and if ye shall see the Son of man ascend up where he was before?
倘或你們看見人子升到他原來所在之處，怎麼樣呢？

S.FORM: Joep-pan ta pa-kæuægh: sauki-nynno ta vaät. Joep-pan ki kæuag-han-appa ta sou ka pa-sousou-en-nau ymoumi-an.
S.TRANSL: It is the spirit that quickeneth; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, they are spirit, and they are life.
叫人活着的乃是靈，肉體是無益的。我對你們所說的話就是靈，就是生命。

S.FORM: Râ akoumea ki rarouma ymoumi-æn ka assi tna-'msing. Ka kavan'nan ti Jesus tou nau-namou na mamang ta neni ka assi tna-msing, ti-mang-appa ta teni ka sivannavanna-ah tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: But there are some of you that believe not. For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were that believed not, and who should betray him.
只是你們中間有不信的人。」耶穌從起頭就知道誰不信他，誰要賣他。

S.FORM: Ka ni-k'ma ta teni, Alei ki atta ni-pa-sousou-en-nau-kamou, ka assi mou-lpough ta ti-mamang mou-koua jau-an, rou assi pæp'æp-'æ̈ ta atta tyni-æn ki Rama-au.
S.TRANSL: And he said, Therefore said I unto you, that no man can come unto me, except it were given unto him of my Father.
耶穌又說：「所以我對你們說過，若不是蒙我父的恩賜，沒有人能到我這裏來。」

S.FORM: Tou kidi kanna ni-d'ma-rang mææu-lyk-kough ta maba-toung ka Pæhtatæutæu-han tyn, ka assi ni-mou-naunang hmi-lala tou lam tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: From that time many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.
從此，他門徒中多有退去的，不再和他同行。

S.FORM: Annata ni-k'ma ta ti Jesus ki saat-kyttiæn k'anna æb ki rou-ha, Mamoei-appa kauwa d'mma-rang ta ymoumi?
S.TRANSL: Then said Jesus unto the twelve, Will ye also go away?
耶穌就對那十二個門徒說：「你們也要去嗎？」

S.FORM: Ni-mattæ'i-vlli tyni-æn ta ti Simon Petrus, Meirang, d'mmarang-ah-kame mou-koua ti-mang-an? akoumea-kow ki sou ki kæuag-han ka myhkakoua myddaryn-nough.
S.TRANSL: Then Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life.
西門‧彼得回答說：「主啊，你有永生之道，我們還歸從誰呢？

S.FORM: Ka ni-tna-msing-kame ka ni-mou-mhga-kame, ka ti Chri-stus kow, Alak ki Alid ka mæu-agh.
S.TRANSL: And we believe and are sure that thou art that Christ, the Son of the living God.
我們已經信了，又知道你是上帝的聖者。」

S.FORM: Ni-mattæ'i-v'lli ta ti Je-sus neini-æn, Assi-mau-kamou kauwa ni-peri ta sasat kyttiæn 'ab ki rouha? ra sasat ymoumi-æn ta Littou?
S.TRANSL: Jesus answered them, Have not I chosen you twelve, and one of you is a devil?
耶穌說：「我不是揀選了你們十二個門徒嗎？但你們中間有一個是魔鬼。」

S.FORM: Ka ni-pa-sousou-en tyn [ta atta] mattæ'i-mymmia ti Judas-an ka ti Simon Iskarioth. Ka teni ta si-vanavana-âl-ato tyni-æn, ka saäsat ta teni ki saäsat kytti-æn 'æb ki rouha.
S.TRANSL: He spake of Judas Iscariot the son of Simon: for he it was that should betray him, being one of the twelve.
耶穌這話是指着加略人西門的兒子猶大說的；他本是十二個門徒裏的一個，後來要賣耶穌的。
